wargearItems.name: Form of Supreme Nobility
effects: This upgrade can only be taken by your Warlord. This model:
Must have a base size between 40mm to 60mm
wargearItems.effectsHtml:
This upgrade can only be taken by your Warlord. This model:

  • Increases its Movement characteristic by 2"
  • Increases its Weapons Skill by 2
  • Increases its Ballistics Skill by 2
  • Increases its Initiative characteristic by 2
  • Increases its Strength characteristic by 2
  • Increases its Toughness characteristic by 1
  • Increases its Wounds characteristic by 3
  • Gains the Relentless ability
  • Gains the Fearless ability
  • Must have a base size between 40mm to 60mm

wargearItems.name: Command Barge
effects: This upgrade can only be taken by your Warlord. This model:
Reduces its Activation Points characteristic by 1
Must select 1 of the following: 1 Gauss Cannon, 1 Tesla Cannon

When equipped with a Command Barge, a Necron Lord cannot Lead any other Necron units. However, a Necron Lord equipped with a Command Barge increases the number of friendly and enemy units eligible to be selected as part of the My Will Be Done ability from 3 to 5.

Cannot be equipped by a model equipped any of the following: Form of Supreme Nobility, Noble of the Skorpek Destroyer Cult, Noble of the Ophydian Destroyer Cult, Noble of the Ophydian Destroyer Cult, Mantle of Living Metal.

wargearItems.name: Mantle of Living Metal
effects: Models equipped with a Mantle of Living Metal:
Add 2 to the value of Necrodermis rolls
Cannot be equipped by a model equipped any of the following: Noble of the Lokhust Destroyer Cult, Noble of the Skorpek Destroyer Cult, Noble of the Ophydian Destroyer Cult.
wargearItems.effectsHtml:
Models equipped with a Mantle of Living Metal:

  • Add 2 to their Wounds characteristic
  • Gain the Invulnerable Save 5+ ability
  • Add 2 to the value of Necrodermis rolls

Cannot be equipped by a model equipped any of the following: Noble of the Lokhust Destroyer Cult, Noble of the Skorpek Destroyer Cult, Noble of the Ophydian Destroyer Cult.

wargearItems.name: Resurrection Orb
effects: While a model equipped with a Resurrection Orb is leading a unit, return D6+2 Wounds to that unit when using the Necrodermis ability.
wargearItems.effectsHtml: While a model equipped with a Resurrection Orb is leading a unit, return D6+2 Wounds to that unit when using the Necrodermis ability.

wargearItems.name: Chronometron
effects: While a model equipped with a Chronometron is leading a unit, once per Battle Round, that unit can Move immediately after being declared the target of an enemy Ranged attack.
wargearItems.effectsHtml: While a model equipped with a Chronometron is leading a unit, once per Battle Round, that unit can Move immediately after being declared the target of an enemy Ranged attack.

wargearItems.name: Phase Shifter
effects: Models equipped with a Phase Shifter gain the Phase Shift ability.
wargearItems.effectsHtml: Models equipped with a Phase Shifter gain the Phase Shift ability.

wargearItems.name: Nightmare Shroud
effects: Enemy units within 6" of this model reduce their Leadership characteristic to 9+.
wargearItems.effectsHtml: Enemy units within 6" of this model reduce their Leadership characteristic to 9+.

wargearItems.name: Veil of Darkness
effects: While a model equipped with a Veil of Darkness is leading a unit, that unit has access to the Ascend to the Skies action and the Deep Strike ability.
wargearItems.effectsHtml: While a model equipped with a Veil of Darkness is leading a unit, that unit has access to the Ascend to the Skies action and the Deep Strike ability.

wargearItems.name: Nebuloscope
effects: Ranged attacks by models equipped with a Nebuloscope - and by models being led by a model equipped with a Nebuloscope - gain the Ignores Cover ability. Weapons equipped by the unit that already possess the Ignores Cover ability instead add 1 to their Hit roles.
wargearItems.effectsHtml: Ranged attacks by models equipped with a Nebuloscope - and by models being led by a model equipped with a Nebuloscope - gain the Ignores Cover ability. Weapons equipped by the unit that already possess the Ignores Cover ability instead add 1 to their Hit roles.

wargearItems.name: Shadowloom
effects: The bearer gains the Stealth ability.
wargearItems.effectsHtml: The bearer gains the Stealth ability.

wargearItems.name: Dispersion Shield
effects: Models equipped with a Dispersion Shield gain the Invulnerable Save 5+ ability and increase their Toughness characteristic by 3 against Ranged attacks.
wargearItems.effectsHtml: Models equipped with a Dispersion Shield gain the Invulnerable Save 5+ ability and increase their Toughness characteristic by 3 against Ranged attacks.

wargearItems.name: Gloom Prism
effects: Friendly Necron Infantry units with models that are within 6" of a model equipped with a Gloom Prism gain the Feel No Pain 5+ ability.
wargearItems.effectsHtml: Friendly Necron Infantry units with models that are within 6" of a model equipped with a Gloom Prism gain the Feel No Pain 5+ ability.

wargearItems.name: Twin-linked
effects: For weapons or Weapon Attack Profiles with a Strength characteristic of 7 or less, increase the Attacks characteristic by 3
For weapons or Weapon Attack Profiles with a Strength characteristic of 8 or more, increase the Attacks characteristic by 1
The Twin-Linked upgrade doubles the points cost of the weapon being upgraded.
wargearItems.effectsHtml:
Weapon gains the Twin-linked ability:

  • For weapons or Weapon Attack Profiles with a Strength characteristic of 7 or less, increase the Attacks characteristic by 3
  • For weapons or Weapon Attack Profiles with a Strength characteristic of 8 or more, increase the Attacks characteristic by 1

The Twin-Linked upgrade doubles the points cost of the weapon being upgraded.
